verdict.rationale: Evidence shows webhooks for event-driven notifications and an MCP server with on-demand tools (e.g., listOfContracts, createTimeOffRequest), but nothing describes scheduling recurring jobs, cron-like automation, or workflow scheduling that an AI agent could set up. Missing for 10: any documented scheduler/cron API, recurring job configuration, or workflow automation trigger beyond real-time webhooks and on-demand tool calls.
